chip.description: Fixed-function math coprocessor: unsigned divide, modulo and square root over 16-bit operands, an LFSR random-number source, a bounding-box collision test and a programmable NMI timer.
chip.notes: Register map and function from src/mame/konami/k051733.cpp in MAME 0.288, whose device full name is "Konami 051733 math chip" (00-05 W operands; 00-01 R quotient, 02-03 R remainder, 04-05 R sqrt, 06 R LFSR, 07 R collision flags; 10-13 W NMI timer). Filed dsp on taxonomy §4.3's discriminator that "a documented math engine is dsp even when it is a board-specific part"; Q2's microcode clause does not fit fixed-silicon arithmetic, so this is a judgement call flagged for review. konamiic.txt annotates it "(protection)", but TB6 reserves protection for parts designed to enforce security and MAME documents this one as arithmetic, so protection was rejected.
